Hi Soojin / Ben / Liam — thanks for the note. Tue Jul 20 08:30 for a quick IT touch and 09:00 for the demo both work for us.

Quick answers:
- We prefer that vendors provide static outbound IPs to whitelist; ephemeral ranges are tough for our firewall team.
- HTTPS (443) only is fine; we block other outbound ports by default.
- We will accept a demo token or a short-lived test account for smoke checks.
- We have a corporate proxy; I'll include details on the pre-call.

Attaching our corporate firewall template so your SE can see the columns we need filled (IP / port / protocol / justification).

Sara Vogel | Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Novacorp
sara.vogel@novacorp.com

Attachment: corporate-firewall-rules.xlsx

Thanks Sara — sending a quick checklist and confirming we'll provide the following for the IT pre-call / whitelist doc:
- Static egress IPs to whitelist: 34.210.12.5, 34.210.12.6 (region: eu-west-1 egress NAT)
